product_overview: FleAxovA is a premium, corporate-style full-stack freelancing platform exclusively for students. It enables verified student freelancers to offer paid digital services, receive secure payments, manage orders, build credibility through reviews, and operate within a highly secure, streamlined environment.
core_goals: Provide a secure and seamless JWT-based authentication system for students and admins.
Enable student freelancers to create and manage verified profiles with portfolios and skills.
Facilitate a marketplace for paid service listings with category discovery and search functionalities.
Support a robust job and order management system ensuring payment before work starts and smooth delivery workflows.
Implement a secure payment gateway with wallet management, platform commission, and withdrawal processes.
Enable real-time messaging and notification systems to enhance communication and engagement.
Build trust through a review and rating system post-completion of orders.
Offer personalized dashboards for students and clients with analytics.
Provide an admin panel for comprehensive platform and user management.
Ensure responsive, clean UI/UX with corporate premium styling, optimized for both desktop and mobile.
key_features: JWT-based Authentication with login, registration, password reset, and role-based access control.
Student freelancer profile management including skills, portfolio, bio, and social link editing.
Service Marketplace with paid-only services, category-based browsing, creation, and detailed service pages.
Job Board allowing clients to post jobs and students to apply, with application management.
Order Management system tracking order status, delivery submissions, and client approvals.
Secure Payment & Wallet integration supporting escrow, platform commissions, and withdrawal requests.
Real-time Messaging system facilitating communication between clients and freelancers.
Review and Rating features enabling post-order feedback with anti-spam controls.
Notification System for order updates, messages, and platform news with read/unread status.
Personalized User Dashboards for students and clients showing active engagements and analytics.
Admin Panel for user, service, job, order, and payment monitoring and moderation.
Application-wide Navigation & Route Protection ensuring secure, role-appropriate access.
Responsive Landing Page presenting platform features and value propositions.
Comprehensive database schema covering all entities like users, profiles, services, orders, reviews, messages, notifications, and withdrawals.
user_flow_summary: User Registration and Login flow with JWT authentication and secure session management.
Student freelancers create and edit verified profiles showcasing skills and portfolios.
Clients or students browse or search the service marketplace by category and can view detailed service pages.
Clients post jobs and students apply via the job board system, managing applications.
Clients place orders for services, make payments securely before work starts, and track order progress.
Freelancers submit digital work deliveries; clients review and approve to complete orders.
Users communicate in real-time via messaging; notifications alert users of status changes and messages.
Post-order, clients submit reviews and ratings to build freelancer credibility.
Students and clients access personalized dashboards presenting their activities, orders, and analytics.
Admins use their panel for managing users, moderating services, overseeing jobs/orders, and handling payments and withdrawals.
validation_criteria: All authentication flows must be secure, using JWT and password hashing with Bcryptjs.
Only verified students can register as freelancers; admin can moderate profiles and services.
All services listed must be paid; no free work allowed on the platform.
Payment must be confirmed before order acceptance; platform commissions are correctly deducted.
Wallet balance updates and withdrawal requests function securely with admin approval for withdrawals.
Real-time messaging shows accurate message delivery and read statuses.
Notifications update correctly for orders, messages, and platform events; read/unread statuses persist.
Reviews are only posted after order completion and contain star ratings with anti-spam controls.
Dashboard data reflect real-time user interactions and system state without errors.
Admin panel permissions restrict access to only authorized users; moderation actions are logged and effective.
UI/UX maintains corporate, clean, and responsive design standards across devices.
API endpoints are securely implemented with input validation and meaningful error handling.
